name: Reduce browser MCP context with Direct Tools and discovery

description: Baseline harness failed before reaching MCP because the helper computed the repository root as its parent.

asi.hypothesis: Baseline harness should read actual MCP tool schemas for both exposure paths.
asi.rollback_reason: The measurement helper resolved packageRoot one directory above the repository and could not open mcp.json; no product files were changed.
asi.next_action_hint: Correct the root path and rerun the baseline.

description: Baseline: measured live MCP schemas for native fallback and package adapter exposure.

asi.hypothesis: Native fallback currently sends all registered tool schemas directly, while adapter sends only 16 direct schemas.
asi.finding: Native context is 61,213 schema bytes across 84 tools; adapter context is 10,842 bytes across 16 direct tools. Because the fallback uses hidden as server default and overrides all tools direct, no tools remain available through codemode discovery.
asi.next_action_hint: Align native fallback exposure with adapter: use codemode as default and mark the existing common allowlist direct.

description: Match native fallback to the adapter: 16 frequent tools direct, remaining MCP tools codemode-discoverable.

asi.hypothesis: Aligning native fallback with adapter's existing 16-tool direct allowlist while setting the default exposure to codemode should cut initial schema bytes and retain all advanced tools for discovery.
asi.finding: Native direct schemas now exactly match the adapter at 10,842 bytes (16 tools), down 82.3% from the measured pre-change native baseline of 61,213 bytes (84 tools). All 68 other registered tools remain available in the MCP server and are codemode-discoverable; full checks pass.
asi.next_action_hint: Review whether the existing 16 direct tools cover everyday navigation, inspection, and interaction before trying any further reduction.

name: Reduce initial MCP context with deferred browser discovery
